query_normalized: predicting plant disease severity from publicly available image data and meteorological records biology
rationale: This paper satisfies criterion (b) by providing a canonical dataset and empirical baseline for the independent variable (plant disease images) within the user's specific domain (apple foliar diseases), which is a necessary component for building a model to predict disease severity. Additionally, it addresses criterion (f) as a foundational reference in the "plant disease classification" vocabulary cluster, establishing the standard data and methods for image-based plant pathology analysis.
